description:
User approved 2026-11-24: "fixtures changes approved; keep it simple."

Why: the block table in .agent/docs/fixtures.md (lines ~105-136) has an "in use through NNNNN" column. Every PR that adds a fixture edits it, so PRs in one epic conflict on the same line, and PRs in neighbouring epics conflict on adjacent lines. On 2026-11-24 this was the only conflict shared by all seven rebased Elixir Parity PRs (#830-834, #845, #846), and it also hit #843. The column is also derivable from fixtures/, and it cannot see numbers taken by open PRs.

Change:
1. The table keeps only Block and Owner. Drop the State column. The table changes only when an epic claims a new block.
2. The fixtures doc says how to find the next free number in a block: the highest existing fixtures/<block-prefix>* file, plus open PRs.
3. A test fails if two fixtures share a number, or if a fixture's number lies in no claimed block. It reads the claims from the table.

Keep it simple: no per-block files and no helper tool.

Removal: the State column and the habit of editing it. Note for fz-nhb.19, which adds another per-fixture list to fixtures.md: the same conflict concern applies.
title: Fixture number blocks record ownership only; a test guards the numbers
